rationale.edition: The change spans both OSS and enterprise-owned paths. OSS paths dominate the backend/UI change (src/api/common/src/auth/validator.rs, src/api/management/src/request/organization/*.rs, src/core/src/ingestion_tokens.rs, src/core/src/organization.rs, web/src/** including web/src/views/Ingestion.vue and web/src/components/ingestion/**). Enterprise paths are o2_openfga/src/authorizer/authz.rs and o2_openfga/src/meta/route_permissions.rs, which live in this o2-enterprise repo and implement the OpenFGA/RBAC passcode explicit-grant layer referenced by the new require_credential_access() under #[cfg(feature = "enterprise")]. The diff is a linked OSS+ENT sister pair, so edition is 'both'.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. There is no explicit opt-out (trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are empty; no tests-added label in context). The change is user-facing: the Ingestion page and its credential-bearing setup cards now withhold passcode-embedded snippets and render a warning banner when the passcode endpoint returns 403.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. A non-admin user's visit to the Ingestion page (and the CopyContent/AI integration/data-source setup cards) now shows a 'Admin or Root role required' warning banner and hides the curl/basic-auth snippet instead of rendering a dead credential; an admin still sees the real token. This is a real, testable UI flow with a role-dependent branch in web/src/**.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI change lives in web/src/views/Ingestion.vue and web/src/components/ingestion/**, which is the org-level ingestion setup surface, not a Logs/Metrics/Traces feature. The closest existing test folder is GeneralTests, which already holds the sibling ingestion-config.spec.js and serviceAccount.spec.js specs, so the new spec belongs there.
rationale.group: The GeneralTests shard (testfolder GeneralTests, actual_folder GeneralTests in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix_env.json) already runs ingestion-config.spec.js and serviceAccount.spec.js, which cover the same org-level ingestion/credential surface, so the new spec should join that group's run_files.
rationale.existing_tests: The diff modifies two Playwright E2E specs (tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/RUM/rum-cdn-dataflow.spec.js and rum-page-dataflow.spec.js) plus the shared util tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/utils/rum-traffic.js, so existing_tests_in_diff is mechanically true. However, those RUM dataflow specs are unrelated to this feature (they make CDN dataflow tests skip instead of fail when the live CDN SDK bundle never initialises) and provide no coverage for the new passcode-forbidden behavior. The remaining test changes (CopyContent.spec.ts, AIIntegrationCard.spec.ts, Ingestion.spec.ts) are Vitest unit tests, which are not E2E coverage. The Architect should append a new GeneralTests spec rather than extend these RUM specs.
